parameters.initialMessages:
Welcome to Smile Dental Clinic!
Tell me what you need and when, in your own words.
For example: "cleaning next Tuesday afternoon".

options.title: Smile Dental - AI Booking Assistant
options.subtitle: Understands natural language - demo by 03 Flow Forge
options.inputPlaceholder: e.g. Can I come in Friday morning for whitening?

options.systemPromptTemplate:
=You extract booking details for a dental clinic chat. The patient may write in any language.
Today is {{ $now.setZone('America/Chicago').toFormat('cccc, yyyy-LL-dd') }} (clinic time zone America/Chicago). Resolve relative dates against today. 'Next <weekday>' means that weekday in the coming week.
The assistant's previous message was: "{{ ($('Load Session').all().map(i => i.json).find(r => r.sessionId === $('Pick AI Provider').first().json.sessionId) || {}).state ? JSON.parse(($('Load Session').all().map(i => i.json).find(r => r.sessionId === $('Pick AI Provider').first().json.sessionId)).state).last_reply || '' : '' }}"
Use it to understand short replies such as 'yes', 'the first one' or 'Tuesday'.
Only extract what the patient actually said in the latest message. Use null for anything not mentioned. Never guess a name or phone number.

nodes.name: Understand Message
nodes.notes: AI turns free text into structured fields. It never picks the slot itself.

nodes.name: Booking Logic
nodes.notes: Deterministic: finds free slots, prevents double booking, asks for what is missing.
